author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices twirling finger patterns, a pattern that moves up, counting repeats and a steady left-hand drum, using Mozart's bouncy marching tune.

classes.title: The little twirl
classes.goal: Set the hand by the black key next to A and learn the twirl that circles A.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune circles around one note, then jumps away

classes.parentPrompt: Draw a small circle in the air with your child's finger, then a hop up.
classes.childAction: Play B, A, black key, A, then hop to C.
classes.bridge: The notes twirl round A like a dancer, then hop up to C.

intro.caption: A little twirl round A
intro.parentCue: draw a circle in the air together

games.caption: Twirl round A, hop to C
games.parentCue: Say three, two, one, two, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a finger pattern that circles one note.

classes.title: Twirl again, one step up
classes.goal: Learn the next steps and hear the same twirl move one step higher.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same twirl, moved one key higher

classes.parentPrompt: Play the first twirl, then this one, and ask: 'Same or different?'
classes.childAction: Play D, C, B, C, then hop to E: the twirl moved up.
classes.bridge: The dancer takes one step to the right and twirls again.

intro.caption: Same twirl, one step up
intro.parentCue: ask your child: same or different?

games.caption: Twirl round C, hop to E
games.parentCue: Say three, two, one, two, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a pattern that moves one step up.

classes.title: Steps, twirls, top, home
classes.goal: Play the whole tune slowly and name its parts: steps, twirls, the top note, home.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune has parts in order: steps, twirls, top, home

classes.parentPrompt: Call out each part as it starts: 'Steps! Twirls! Top! Home!' Let your child join in.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and call out each part as you reach it.
classes.bridge: The parade marches up the street, twirls, reaches the top, then marches home.

intro.caption: Steps, twirls, top, home
intro.parentCue: call out each part as it starts

games.caption: Back home: five steps down
games.parentCue: Walk your fingers down your child's arm

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: naming the parts of a tune in order.

classes.title: Count the twirls up high
classes.goal: Practise the high twirls slowly and count how many times they repeat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting how many times the same little group comes back

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up a finger for each twirl your child plays and count them together.
classes.childAction: Play the high twirl slowly, twice. How many twirls?
classes.bridge: Up high on the right, the dancer twirls, and twirls again: one, two.

intro.caption: How many twirls?
intro.parentCue: hold up a finger for each twirl

games.caption: Twirl, twirl, up high
games.parentCue: Count one, two for the twirls

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting a pattern that repeats.

classes.title: The big march drum
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar, like a big drum.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low drum note that comes back every bar

classes.parentPrompt: March in place and say 'boom, two, three, four'; your child plays low A on 'boom'.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low A on every boom.
classes.bridge: Low notes on the left are the big parade drum: Boom, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Boom, two, three, four
intro.parentCue: march in place and say it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one low note at the start of each bar.

classes.title: Drum while the band plays
classes.goal: Keep the left-hand drum notes going at full speed while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different parts fit together into one march

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod on each 'boom'; if the drum stops, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Keep your drum going while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The drummer keeps marching even when the trumpets run fast.

intro.caption: You drum, I play
intro.parentCue: nod on each boom and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part going while another plays.

classes.title: Drum and twirl, slowly
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand drum note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One drum note while the right hand plays eight quick notes

classes.parentPrompt: Count very slowly and tap your child's left hand at the start of each bar.
classes.childAction: Left hand drums once, right hand twirls along.
classes.bridge: One big drum step while the right hand dances eight little steps.

intro.caption: Drum and twirl, slowly
intro.parentCue: tap their left hand at each bar's start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands with different jobs, slowly.

classes.title: Strong step, light steps
classes.goal: Play both hands a bit faster, with a strong first beat and light notes after.

mathTarget.parentLine: One strong beat, then lighter ones, like a march

classes.parentPrompt: Stamp gently on each first beat and tiptoe the rest; slow down if hands tangle.
classes.childAction: Play the first beat strong, the rest light and quick.
classes.bridge: The first beat is a boot stamp; the quick notes are jingling bells.

intro.caption: Stamp, then jingle
intro.parentCue: stamp gently on each first beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: strong and light notes at a faster speed.

classes.title: March with the band
classes.goal: Play the whole tune along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: March your feet beside your child; if they slip, keep marching and keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep marching after a slip.
classes.bridge: The band never stops marching; you jump back in at the next step.

intro.caption: Join the marching band!
intro.parentCue: march your feet and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: Parade for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole tune for teddy like a proud little marching band.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing together like a marching band, start to finish

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; march in, play together, then bow like a band.
classes.childAction: March to the piano, play for teddy, then bow.
classes.bridge: Drums boom, bells jingle, and the parade marches home to A.

intro.caption: The parade is coming!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front and march in together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole tune together, like a band.
